rows.claim: the tuned-config CSV has the documented 18-column schema
rows.detail: 18 columns as documented

rows.claim: AITER_LOG_TUNED_CONFIG is the engagement signal, and rows are keyed by cu_num
rows.detail: 9195 of 9964 rows across 8 tables reachable at cu_num=256; unreachable: a8w8_tuned_batched_gemm.csv 0/26, bf16_tuned_batched_gemm.csv 0/26, tuned_fmoe.csv 0/622

rows.detail: --kernel-trace supported

rows.claim: the arch limits the skill reasons about are readable, not assumed
rows.detail: gfx950: CU=256, warp=64, LDS/workgroup=163840

rows.claim: aiter ships seven CK offline tuners, and none of them takes --indtype
rows.detail: aiter is a wheel here -- csrc/ tuners ship only in the source checkout

rows.claim: the AITER_CONFIG_<OP> override has no _FILE suffix; the _FILE name is a property
rows.detail: no-suffix form redirects; _FILE form is silently ignored

rows.claim: the shipped fused-MoE shape list is gfx942-only and will not run here
rows.detail: 11 of 13 rows are FNUZ and cannot run on gfx950; gemm_moe_tune.py raises KeyError and tunes 0 shapes. Filter with `grep -v fnuz`.

rows.claim: CK gates instances on an exact get_device_name() string, so the candidate pool differs between parts (SKILL.md 2b)
rows.detail: 87 gates exclude on gfx950 and 79 add only there; exclusions touch: batched_gemm_softmax_gemm_permute gemm_universal gemm_universal_batched gemm_universal_reduce gemm_universal_streamk grouped_conv2d_fwd grouped_conv2d_fwd_bias_bnorm_clamp grouped_conv2d_fwd_bias_clamp grouped_conv2d_fwd_clamp grouped_conv3d_fwd grouped_conv3d_fwd_bias_bnorm_clamp grouped_conv3d_fwd_bias_clamp grouped_conv3d_fwd_clamp

rows.claim: the gfx950 Tensile logic tree is split by selection strategy and is Origami-dominated, unlike gfx942's CU-count split (SKILL.md 7)
rows.detail: Origami is 83% of 566 gfx950 logic files {'Equality': 25, 'GridBased': 67, 'Origami': 471, 'Range': 3}; gfx942 splits by CU count instead (7 dirs, no Origami)

rows.claim: gradlib's gemm_tuner.py has no --libtype flag; libtype is an output column
rows.detail: gradlib tuner ships only in the aiter source checkout

rows.claim: vLLM reads tuned configs from VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER
rows.detail: vllm 0.21.0 reads it in 3 file(s)

rows.detail: sglang not installed in this image

rows.claim: SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR must name the parent of configs/, and naming the version dir raises

rows.detail: sglang not installed in this image

rows.claim: an idle-GPU check exists, so 'pin your GPUs' is actionable
rows.detail: 8 GPUs reporting utilization

rows.claim: relative error is the gate; bf16 at K=4096 shows why absolute is not
rows.detail: abs=0.934 but rel=0.00315 -- absolute error alone would look alarming

rows.claim: fp8 dialect is arch-specific: exactly one of FNUZ/OCP computes
rows.detail: float8_e4m3fn computes; float8_e4m3fnuz refused with 'could not find valid hipblaslt solution'

rows.claim: LDS per workgroup is read from the device, and any two sources agree
rows.detail: 163840 bytes from rocminfo+torch

rows.claim: Gluon exposes a cdna4 dialect, and it is the gfx950-only surface
rows.detail: cdna3+cdna4 present; cdna4 has mfma_scaled and scale layout

rows.claim: microscaled FP4 is reachable on gfx950, and torch.zeros is the wrong probe
rows.detail: mxfp4 runs via both torch._scaled_mm and aiter; torch.zeros still raises, so probing with it would report FP4 unsupported on the one arch that has it
